title: The narrowest statement that still fits
description: Restrictiveness favors the narrowest grammar statement that covers known valid forms and excludes explicitly forbidden readings. An unattested form is not a negative without suitable evidence.
helpPage:
# Restrictiveness

Restrictiveness favors the narrowest grammar statement that still covers known valid forms and excludes readings people have explicitly forbidden. A form missing from the chosen Texts is unobserved; that absence alone does not make it bad.
